title: Detection of Coronary Artery Disease With Micro Electro-Mechanical Sensors
brief_summary: This study aims to validate the sensor data of gyroscope and accelerometer in detection of hemodynamically significant CAD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Patients visiting hospital for suspected CAD and undergoing CCTA
* Signed informed consent as an acceptance to participate to the trial

Exclusion Criteria:

* informed consent not signed
study_population: Study includes patients who are referred to a CCTA imaging in Turku University hospital, Turku, Finland due to suspected CAD.
